title: Photograph of the French Quarter nightclub
summary: A photo of the club Billie worked in the French Quarter, which De De says was painted by a sailor.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition

blocks.x: Two sailors gave me this picture.

In the nightclub I was waking at. That was around the French quarters. I was waking for a little unchantill. That's the pig pen used to be. That was the pig pen. Oh yeah. Oh, did you know that pig pen?
Yeah, well you know that pig pen.
Sailor gave me that. I don't know who he was saying. Ernest, what did you say?
He painted the place inside. He painted the place inside. It's a beautiful place. Painted by trade.
That's why little niece, she's in the school. You know, a concert with Mark at a wedding, you know. And a play.
She must have been quite young then.
She was. She's been around about, she must have been around about five years old.
